subject: Consolidated step-up tiers & blended pricing for EdenHealth
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@edenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Consolidated step-up tiers & blended pricing for EdenHealth

Hi Alex —

Great to meet yesterday. As promised, below is a short recap + immediate asks so we can turn this into a firm commitment and SOW. I pulled the numbers we discussed and sketched two blended approaches depending on whether you prefer larger committed steps or a more gradual ramp.

Recap from the call:
- Current baseline (today): ~200M tokens/mo across our legacy summarization route.
- Near-term ask: add two new routes — clinical-summary (heavy overlapping prefixes) and patient-qna (shorter average response).
- Target uplift windows you outlined: 12–18 months to reach 2B tokens/mo (base case) or 5B tokens/mo (aggressive).
- Procurement goal: target unit economics around $X–$Y per 1M tokens (you said $/1M tokens target range — I asked for a concrete number).

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm projected month-by-month volumes for next 12 months (bands OK) and whether the new routes will have the same SLA/latency needs?
2) Your target blended $/1M tokens that the procurement team will push for (ballpark is fine).
3) Who should we put on the SOW and legal thread (procurement contact + billing)?

What I'm attaching: a first-pass pricing workbook (redwood-blend-models-v2.xlsx) that shows two options:
• Option A — Tiered commit with step-ups at 500M, 2B, 5B tokens; deeper discounts at each step.
• Option B — Blended-rate commitment with monthly true-up and an annual top-up that smooths to a single blended $/1M.

Suggested next step: you confirm volumes and preferred commercial structure; we’ll run exact blended math and produce a clean SOW draft for procurement.

If you want, we can do a short follow-up demo with the engineering lead to validate latency for clinical-summary route.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: redwood-blend-models-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@edenhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@edenhealth.com>, EdenHealth Procurement <procurement@edenhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 10:32:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Consolidated step-up tiers & blended pricing for EdenHealth

Markus —

Thanks for the recap and the workbook. Quick answers below and a bit more color on volumes and budget:

Volumes (monthly bands, conservative -> aggressive):
- Q1–Q2 ramp: 250M -> 600M tokens/mo (pilot + clinical-summary pilot).
- Q3–Q4: 1.2B -> 2.0B tokens/mo (production for clinical-summary + more users).
- FY end (12–18 months): 2.0B -> 5.0B tokens/mo depending on adoption.

Route mix and token shape:
- clinical-summary: long outputs, high avg tokens/request (~1.2k).
- patient-qna: short requests (~120 tokens) but high QPS.

Budget / target unit economics:
- Procurement is aiming for a blended target of around $380–$540 per 1M tokens depending on commitment length.
- If we can get under $450/1M with a 12–18 month committed ramp, procurement will prioritize.

Procurement contact:
- Priya Gupta (Cc) is our lead for legal/billing — please route SOW there.

Other asks:
- We’ll likely add one additional model variant for clinical work (Redwood-med-insight). Please include any model-mix effects in blended math.
- Can you show a blended example that treats long-output routes at 1.6x token-weighting (to capture cost footprint)? That will help our finance team.

Happy to hop on a 30 min call if you want to walk through the workbook.

—Alex
Head of Product — AI
EdenHealth
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@edenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@edenhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidated step-up tiers & blended pricing for EdenHealth

Alex / Priya —

Appreciate the banded volumes and the procurement target — very helpful. I ran the numbers and attached a compact CSV with the blended calcs (pricing-calcs-EDN-052.csv). Summary below — I show two commercial constructs that meet your $/1M target range depending on how you want to trade coverage vs. price.

Summary (high level):
Option 1 — Aggressive step-up commit (best unit economics):
- Commit: 2B tokens/mo (12–18 month ramp to 2B).
- Blended rate (all routes, weight long outputs 1.6x): $420 per 1M tokens.
- Credits: 6% onboarding credit for first 60 days; 3% annual true-up rebate for growth above committed tiers.

Option 2 — Gradual blended commitment (more flexibility):
- Commit: 700M tokens/mo average over year with monthly true-up and annual reconciliation.
- Blended rate: $525 per 1M tokens (satisfies procurement mid-range).
- Includes a 90-day pilot at $450/1M for up to 500M tokens total to validate latency and route behavior.

Notes on model mix & route weighting:
- We applied your 1.6x weighting for clinical-summary. That increases effective token count for blended math; details are in pricing-calcs-EDN-052.csv and the workbook.
- If you add Redwood-med-insight as a premium model, the blended rate moves +$30–$45/1M unless you convert it into a separate metered route or commit more capacity.

Next steps (recommended):
1) Confirm which option you prefer (Option 1 vs Option 2) and whether the pilot is acceptable.
2) We prepare a short SOW and send to Priya for procurement/legal review.
3) If you want, we can put a draft DocuSign SOW on the table and run a 30-day performance validation in our dedicated pilot pool.

I’ve attached the compact calcs and updated workbook for your FP&A team. If that looks good I’ll loop in commercial ops to draft the SOW (Marissa will own exec comms).

Thanks,
Markus

Hi Priya / Alex —

Looping in on next steps from the commercial side. Markus shared the two pricing constructs and we’re ready to move to SOW once you confirm the preferred option. Quick checklist for procurement to progress the SOW:

Checklist:
- Confirm Option 1 (2B commit @ $420/1M weighted) OR Option 2 (700M blended @ $525/1M with 90-day pilot at $450/1M).
- Confirm model list to include in the SOW (clinical-summary, patient-qna, Redwood-med-insight).
- Provide billing entity + PO contact and any standard contract language we should expect (redlines are fine).

Attached: SOW-draft-edenhealth-2027.pdf (clean draft for review). We’ve kept the pilot clause and step-up schedule editable.

If you can confirm by EOD next Tue, we’ll aim to issue a DocuSign and lock a pilot start date in the following week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
